records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cost of product revenue increased approximately $11.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2024 as compared to 2023, primarily due to higher sales volumes of our memory interface chips.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our continued execution delivered strong results during fiscal year 2024, driven by continued demand for our memory interface chips and our Silicon IP solutions, and stability from our royalties revenue.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Changes in operating assets and liabilities for the year ended December 31, 2024, primarily included decreases in unbilled receivables, prepaids and other current assets and an increase in income taxes payable, offset by increases in accounts receivable, inventories and income tax receivable.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cost of contract and other revenue decreased approximately $2.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2024 as compared to 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We also generated record cash provided by operating activities of $230.6 million in 2024.
